name: Shikon no Toki
source:
Luxury liner Lily Marlene. It's not known to the outside world that many girls aboard are sex slaves. Main character is a gossip writer. His sister dies on board this ship under mysterious circumstances, so his investigation leads him there. Is it only revenge that drives him?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
豪华客轮‘莉莉·玛莲号’。外界并不知道，船上许多女孩都是性奴。主人公是一名八卦记者；姐姐在船上离奇死亡，调查也将他引向这里。驱使他的真的只有复仇吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
